policy_name: Delegation of Financial Powers and Approval Thresholds

tiers.title: Head of Department
tiers.scope: Departmental operational supplies, lab consumables, and minor services within approved annual faculty budget.

tiers.title: University Finance Officer
tiers.scope: IT equipment, software licenses, research grants, and university-wide standard procurement contracts.

tiers.title: Finance Administrator / University Comptroller
tiers.scope: Capital expenditure, major infrastructure, high-value framework contracts, and disputed exceptions.
